title: Finely Crafted CTS
description: A Finely Crafted Vanilla+ Mod Pack Built For MC 1.21.8
body:
![CTS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a587b9cd955a999479dd7b7f8c23216ca422bce9.png)

![Separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a096a091d3e24ffd3905f5f12b2feb40d5a60a60.png)

## DESCRIPTION
Finely Crafted is a Vanilla style modpack that keeps Minecraft\
feeling fresh & true to it's roots. It adds small quality-of-life\
changes, visual improvements, and some nifty tools.

This modpack makes sure that the core gameplay is untouched.

- No Over The Top Game Changing Features
- Nothing Too Confusing To Learn

Just Minecraft, reinvigorated

Perfect for Explorers, Builders & Survivalists

![Separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a096a091d3e24ffd3905f5f12b2feb40d5a60a60.png)

## OTHER MODS REQUIRED
- **[Armorstands Reimagined](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/armorstands-reimagined)** on **CurseForge**\
(You can also download this via the **Resourcify** mod)

- **[Actually 3D Stuff](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/actually-3d-stuff)** on **Modrinth**\
(Do Not download this via **Resourcify**, download it through the website)

![Separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a096a091d3e24ffd3905f5f12b2feb40d5a60a60.png)

## DISABLED MODS
(these mods are disabled by default, so just enable them if you wish to use them)

- **[Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons)** Some people have performance issues when using this mod.\
(default render distance is set to 64 but this can be increased if needed)\
(I have mine set to 256 render distance but i recommend 128 for most users)

- **[Daily Quests](https://modrinth.com/mod/daily-quests)** This was disabled by choice\
(I thought this was a great addition but felt it should be choice based)\
(Feel free to enable this if you want that extra bit of daily fun)

![Separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a096a091d3e24ffd3905f5f12b2feb40d5a60a60.png)

## FEATURES
- Better Performance
- Useful QOL
- Crisp SFX
- Amazing Particle Effects
- Mob Animations
- Beautiful Visuals
- Immersive Weather
- World Map & Minimap
- Builder Friendly
- Controller Support
- Record & Playback Gameplay
- & Much More

- Also Check The **[Gallery](https://modrinth.com/modpack/finely-crafted-cts/gallery)** For Some Preview Images

![Separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a096a091d3e24ffd3905f5f12b2feb40d5a60a60.png)

## NOTICE
This modpack comes in 2 versions **FOR NOW**.

- **[Finely Crafted CTS](https://modrinth.com/modpack/finely-crafted-cts)** which is built for **[Chase The Skies](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-21-6)** updated to **[MC 1.21.8](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-21-8)<--You Are Here**
- **[Finely Crafted TCA](https://modrinth.com/modpack/finely-crafted-tca)** which is built for **[The Copper Age](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-21-9)** updated to **[MC 1.21.10](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-21-10)**

These modpacks will continue to recieve support to keep mods up to date\
and add more mods as time goes by.

(So please do not expect updates everyday or every week)\
(Updates will happen when they happen)

More versions will come in the future as and when the base game recieves new content.

## AXIOM NOTICE



If you see markers above your crops like this:

![M1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/175fb743b28fe50982df1a317376eb582bef8f29.png)

You can remove them permanently in the config.

To do this you need to do the following:

type the command **/axiomconfig** then follow the images below

---

- Click **Marker/Display Entity Manipulation** On The Left

![AX3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a136cc345005ad4493ebc9488481fc5a1b60c79.png)

- Click **Show Marker Entity Gizmos** On The Right

![AX4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b9785aede930024f37280d2dfa7ae6b2b74c02b.png)

- After you have completed the 2 steps above, click DONE.

![AXX](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/deea75e8963b5ff939f8f91f795a608712c438da.png)

Now they should look like this:

![M2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ecd4e990323b9f391a6080b2a6c2930c3fd11c3.png)

![Separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a096a091d3e24ffd3905f5f12b2feb40d5a60a60.png)
